TOOL_RESULT get_schema:
{"schema": "CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email TEXT,
    region_code TEXT, signup_date TEXT, tier TEXT)
CREATE TABLE order_items (item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, product_id INTEGER,
    quantity INTEGER, unit_price_cents INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, order_ts TEXT,
    status INTEGER, channel TEXT, coupon_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE payments (payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, method TEXT,
    amount_twd INTEGER, paid_ts TEXT, payment_status TEXT)
CREATE TABLE products (product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sku TEXT, product_name TEXT,
    category TEXT, list_price_twd INTEGER, is_active INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE refunds (refund_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, item_id INTEGER,
    refund_amount_twd INTEGER, refund_ts TEXT, reason_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE shipments (shipment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, carrier TEXT,
    shipped_ts TEXT, delivered_ts TEXT)"}

{"thought": "shipments 表有 carrier、shipped_ts、delivered_ts，但時間格式與 Q2 的判定依據還不清楚，先抽樣檢視資料格式與筆數。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT carrier, shipped_ts, delivered_ts FROM shipments ORDER BY shipment_id LIMIT 20"}}

{"thought": "先以 shipped_ts 落在 2025 年 4–6 月定義第二季，計算 delivered_ts 減 shipped_ts 的天數平均；同時檢查未送達與時間倒置的筆數。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_delivered_excluded, SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(delivered_ts) < julianday(shipped_ts) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_rows FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01' AND delivered_ts IS NOT NULL"}}

{"thought": "目前的 2.91 是以 shipped_ts 落在 Q2 且已送達的筆數計算，但我的查詢已排除未送達筆數，需確認 Q2 內未送達數量與時間格式是否一致，再決定是否交付。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_q2, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS undelivered_q2 FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01'", "SELECT COUNT(*) AS bad_format FROM shipments WHERE (shipped_ts IS NOT NULL AND length(shipped_ts) <> 19) OR (delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND length(delivered_ts) <> 19)"]}}

TOOL_RESULT sql_query:
[{"query": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_q2, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS undelivered_q2 FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01'", "columns": ["total_q2", "undelivered_q2"], "rows": [[11128, 1181]], "truncated": false}, {"query": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS bad_format FROM shipments WHERE (shipped_ts IS NOT NULL AND length(shipped_ts) <> 19) OR (delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND length(delivered_ts) <> 19)", "columns": ["bad_format"], "rows": [[0]], "truncated": false}]

{"thought": "目前 Q2 已送達的 9947 筆平均為 2.91 天，但還要檢查極端值與重複 order_id，確認平均不受異常資料影響。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT MIN(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS min_days, MAX(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS max_days, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT carrier) AS carriers FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01' AND delivered_ts IS NOT NULL"}}

response: {"thought": "資料檢查無異常：無負值、時間格式一致、4 家物流商、9947 筆皆為唯一訂單且天數範圍合理（0.63–7.08 天），可交付 2.91。", "tool": "submit_answer", "args": {"answer": "2.91", "basis": "以 shipments.shipped_ts 落在 2025-04-01 至 2025-06-30 定義第二季，只計入已送達（delivered_ts 非空）的 9947 筆，配送天數為 delivered_ts 減 shipped_ts 的天數，跨 4 家物流商合併平均。未送達的 1181 筆排除；資料無負值或時間格式異常。"}}
